components.name: Tutor Worked Board
components.description: Signature: a problem written on a line at a time. Trace, explained, current (yellow) and double-underlined final answer.
components.html:
A car starts from rest and speeds up at 2 m/s² for 5 seconds. How far does it travel?

  1. Given: u = 0, a = 2 m/s², t = 5 s
  2. To find: s, the distance
  3. s = ut + ½at²
  4. s = 0 × 5 + ½ × 2 × 5²
  5. s = 25 m

This equation links distance, time and acceleration, exactly the values we have.
components.css: .ds-t-ground { background: #1E3A2F; padding: 24px; color: #EEEFE6; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-t-q { margin: 0 0 12px; max-width: 48ch; color: #B7C6BB; font-size: 1.05rem; } .ds-t-lines { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 3.4vw, 2.1rem); line-height: 1.45; font-weight: 500; } .ds-t-line { width: fit-content; padding: 2px 0; color: #EEEFE6; opacity: 0.09; transition: color 0.5s ease, opacity 0.5s ease; } .ds-t-line.is-shown { color: #8FA597; opacity: 1; } .ds-t-line.is-current { color: #EBD56C; } .ds-t-line.is-final { text-decoration: underline double; text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; } .ds-t-lines var { font-style: italic; } .ds-t-explain { margin: 16px 0 0; max-width: 46ch; font-size: clamp(1.06rem, 1.6vw, 1.22rem); line-height: 1.5; }

narrative.northStar: Studio: minimal and typographic. Tutor: the page is the classroom board.
narrative.overview: Minimal and typographic. Well-set words, real client screens and honest prices do the persuading. Applies to the studio site (/). The tutoring site is a separate business with its own board world: one board-green field, chalk-white type, and a real problem worked out line by line. Sections are the phases of a written solution: Given, To find, Solution, Answer.
keyCharacteristics: Studio: type carries the page; hairlines separate content; one ink-blue accent; one primary action per view.
Tutor: board green and chalk only; chalk yellow rationed to the book button and the current board line; hairline-ruled phases; one authored motion moment.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Rule
rules.body: Board and chalk carry the whole page. Secondary text is a softer chalk, never a second hue.

rules.name: The Rationed Chalk Rule
rules.body: Chalk yellow marks exactly two things: the primary action (the WhatsApp book button) and the line on the board currently being explained. It is not used for links, headings, rules or decoration. (Text selection and the shared dialog's accent also resolve to yellow through the token mapping.)

rules.name: The Bare Board Rule
rules.body: No cards, shadows, gradients, photos or textures. Separation comes from hairline chalk rules and whitespace.
